title: cyclogramma flexilis
intro: Cyclogramma flexilis, commonly known as Indian Pennywort, is a type of herb used in traditional medicine. The plant has been found to possess various health benefits, including the treatment of anxiety and stress due to its adaptogenic properties, as well as its potential to lower blood sugar levels and improve cognitive function. Therapeutically, Cyclogramma flexilis is thought to exert sedative and anti-inflammatory actions, which contribute to its traditional use in treating insomnia and various inflammatory conditions. Bioactive constituents of the plant, such as flavonoids and alkaloids, are believed to contribute to its therapeutic effects, although further research is needed to fully elucidate its mechanisms of action.
